title: data-layer-adapters
description: Multi-framework adapter collection for the data-layer stack. Holds framework-specific plugin glue, prompts, and DB seed rows. The MCP server under mcp/ is universal and framework-agnostic. Wired into the data-layer umbrella as a sibling submodule.
instructions:
## data-layer-adapters — Multi-Framework Adapter Collection

ACTIVE WORKSPACE: /a0/usr/projects/data-layer/data-layer-adapters. Owns framework-specific code and DB seed rows; does NOT own the postgres schema, redis cache, falkordb graph, or umbrella orchestration.

## Per-framework subdirs

- agent-zero/ — Agent Zero framework family
- hermes-agent/ — Hermes framework family (Nous Research)
- langchain/, crewai/ — future framework families

Each ships its own bootstrap (install | verify | status | reset | seed) and its own seeds/ directory.

## Universal MCP

mcp/server.py is universal. Per-framework tool variants live under mcp/tools/<framework>/ when needed.
